narrative:
LINK revenue in the Q3 Forecast is NOK 7,463M on 24.9bn messages — 30.0 øre per message — and gross profit NOK 1,690M (22.6%).

A2P Messaging is the largest family (NOK 3,070M revenue, NOK 665M GP) but grows GP only +1.8%. Conversational Channels grow GP +30.8% to NOK 280M, and wholesale carries 40% of volume for 7% of GP.

Key risk: January A2P revenue is still at 2026 prices while Nordic termination rises 5–7% — index Enterprise SMS on renewal.

signals.title: Conversational GP +30.8% — WhatsApp adds NOK 40M
signals.source: SDP GP by product family — FY2026 forecast vs FY2025 actual
signals.excerpt: Conversational Channels grow GP to NOK 280M (16.6% of group GP). WhatsApp Business adds +NOK 40M on Meta per-message pricing and template migration; RCS grows +56% from a small base.

signals.title: Nordic operators raise A2P termination 5–7% from 1 January
signals.source: Operator notices (Telenor, Telia, Telia Finland) — Carrier & Termination Cost phase
signals.excerpt: Termination cost is NOK 5,773M, 77% of revenue. Routing absorbs part of the increase; the remainder must be passed through in Enterprise SMS pricing to protect GP per message.

signals.title: Wholesale: 40% of volume, 7% of GP
signals.source: SDP GP per message — 24.9bn messages, FY2026 forecast
signals.excerpt: Carrier Wholesale SMS earns 1.3 øre per message against 16.3 øre for conversational traffic. Every 1bn messages moved from wholesale to conversational adds about NOK 150M of GP at today's unit economics.
